title: Fresno man suspected of DUI injures 2 children after crashing into tree: CHP - NewsBreak
text:
By Cristina Lombardo ,
3 hours ago
MONTEREY COUNTY, Calif. ( KSEE/KGPE ) ‚Äì A Fresno man suspected of DUI was arrested after he crashed into a tree in Monterey County over the weekend, resulting in major injuries for two young children who were in the car with him.
The California Highway Patrol reported that they arrested 25-year-old Daniel Anthony Santos on suspicion of DUI following the crash on Sunday.
At around 4:40 p.m., officers responded to a solo vehicle crash on eastbound Highway 156 east of Cathedral Oaks Road. Investigators said Santos was driving a gray Kia SUV, eastbound on Highway 156. He was accompanied by a 21-year-old woman, a 6-year-old boy and a 7-month-old baby girl.
CHP said that he made an unsafe turn, allowing the Kia to veer across the westbound lane, travel off the roadway and crash into a tree. The woman sustained minor injuries, and the two children both sustained major injuries and were airlifted to a Bay Area hospital.
Santos received minor injuries and was transported to the hospital. CHP said that he was placed under arrest for Driving Under the Influence and booked into the Monterey County Jail.
The crash remains under investigation.
